name: Intracranial Aneurysm (AI4IA)
pi: Philipp Berg, Leonid Goubergrits, Florian Hellmeier, Daniel Behme
institution: Research group Medical Flows, Research Campus STIMULATE, University of Magdeburg “Otto-von-Guericke”
Cardiovascular Modelling and Simulation Group, Institute of Computer-assisted Cardiovascular Medicine (ICM), Deutsches Herzzentrum der Charité
description: Intracranial aneurysm surface model from the AI4IA project, which develops a robust, automated workflow for computing morphologic and hemodynamic rupture-risk parameters — from image acquisition through mesh generation and simulation — while quantifying uncertainty to support clinical decision making.
spp_project: Automated segmentation and DIscrimination for Intracranial Aneurysms (AI4IA): Enhancing robustness of clinical risk scores based on morphology and hemodynamics
